# Parcel fixture capture notes

Captured live on 2026-07-13 from the configured public ArcGIS layers. No fixture in this
directory is marked `# VERIFY`.

- `guilford_parcel.json`: Guilford County `PublishingParcelsSpatialView_FeatureToPointWGS84`.
- `yavapai_parcel.json`: Yavapai County `Parcels_WGS84`.
- `douglas_parcel.json`: Douglas County `Parcels_Enriched`.
- `metro_parcels.json`: one live record from each Phase 17 metro layer: Travis,
  Harris, Dallas, Bexar, Maricopa, Clark, Miami-Dade, Broward, Fulton, and
  Mecklenburg counties. The Dallas city layer is live but its broad county tax
  roll is dated 2019; that limitation is retained in registry tests and output
  provenance rather than presented as current assessment data.
